issue.title: Mac glyph overlays (req hash run, record-route emoji) position by character-count wrap, not the editor's word wrap or scroll
issue.description:
Proposed by research.5u.final (DISCOVERED ISSUE note #6 on epic bob-cli-on, secondary finding; lead verification file:explicit:5c353b4ff461108eaf7e16eb §3.4, gem report file:explicit:0b89e18a8325cc0993d97840). Triaged by the bob-cli-on land agent, who re-read the code on bob-mac-capture master c0959905.

Bob Mac Capture draws requirement hash runs (`RequirementMarkerGlyphOverlay`, CapturePanelView.swift ~1691) and record-route type emoji (the sibling overlay just above it) as SwiftUI overlays. Each one is positioned by `CaptureMonospaceGlyphOrigin.wrappingOrigin` (Sources/CaptureCore/CaptureRecordPresentation.swift:1194). That helper walks the draft one Character at a time and starts a new visual line every `charsPerLine` characters. It is a hard character-count wrap. The NSTextView underneath soft-wraps at word boundaries and gives wide graphemes (emoji, CJK) more than one cell. So when any earlier line soft-wraps at a word boundary, or holds a wide grapheme, the computed (line, column) can differ from the real glyph position. The ⌗ run then lands on the wrong row or column, while the `[ ] ` bytes it replaces are painted clear. Per the research, the overlay also sits outside the editor's scroll view, so a draft taller than the editor can desync on scroll.

Not caused by bob-cli-on as a new defect: the task-requirements plan told mac-authoring to reuse the record-route overlay pattern, and the route-emoji overlay already has the same geometry model. Fix both overlays together. Ask the text system for glyph rects (the NSLayoutManager / NSTextLayoutManager of the editor) and position the overlays inside the scrolling content, rather than modelling wrap arithmetically.

Not reproduced in a live panel by the land agent (no macOS session). It needs one hosted UI repro, for example a long word-wrapped first line followed by a `- [ ] req` row. The code facts above are verified.

task_type_fields.impact: Medium for requirement authoring on the Mac: the requirement marker can vanish (clear bytes) while its glyph draws on a neighbouring row or column. The route-emoji overlay has the same exposure.
task_type_fields.location: bob-mac-capture Sources/CaptureCore/CaptureRecordPresentation.swift:1194 CaptureMonospaceGlyphOrigin.wrappingOrigin; Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelView.swift RequirementMarkerGlyphOverlay and the record-route emoji overlay (~1670-1700, 1874, 1918)
task_type_fields.repro: In Bob Mac Capture, type a first line long enough to soft-wrap at a word boundary (or containing emoji), then '- [ ] req' beneath a task item so bob returns a req_marker span: the ⌗⌗ run is drawn at the arithmetic char-wrap position while the real '[ ] ' cells (painted clear) sit elsewhere. Also scroll a draft taller than the editor.

issue.creation_reason: Display-redesign research verified the Mac overlay geometry ignores word wrap and scrolling; the concealed req checkbox makes a misplaced hash run visible, so the shared overlay model needs a real-layout fix.

payload.description: True-case drawers' Mac phase (ph.8) adds drawer rendering in the same editor; it deliberately never hides drawer markers to avoid the req caret defect

payload.entry: SCOPE NARROWED (bob-cli-pq.5 note #4, triaged by bob-cli-pq.land): bob-mac-capture c6c9c13e deleted RequirementMarkerGlyphOverlay, the requirement byte concealment, and its caret-reveal plumbing; requirement markers now paint their real [ ] bytes as a teal chip inside the NSTextView, so the requirement half of this bug no longer exists (verified on master ff157b0e: no RequirementMarkerGlyphOverlay / concealedRequirementMarkerSpans references). The record-route emoji overlay and CaptureMonospaceGlyphOrigin.wrappingOrigin remain and still need this bead's real-layout fix; the repro is now a soft-wrapped first line followed by a record-route item, not a '- [ ] req' row.

payload.description: Triage pq.5 follow-up to narrow bob-cli-pp after the requirement overlay was deleted
